description: Use this when an OWNER asks what their flat or house is worth (Was ist meine Wohnung wert, Marktwert, valeur de mon bien, quanto vale): returns the link to Heimster's free owner valuation for that address (all of Switzerland, about two minutes, value after a short SMS check, with a personal cockpit). Heimster gives no figure for a specific property here; for area prices use area_market_facts.

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.

name: property_value_range
title: Value of a property (owner valuation)
